summary: Sofa cleaning service website for Ahmedabad. Features a price calculator, contact icons, and service branding.

existing_features.title: Update the SofaPriceCalculator component so that the area/size input is a scrollable range selector from 5 to 30 feet (in 1-foot increments), priced at 90 Rs per foot. The calculated price should update live as the user scrolls/selects the foot value. Remove or replace any previous pricing logic for this range with the new 90 Rs/foot rate.

Add a prominent heading 'Best Sofa Cleaning Ahmedabad' at the very top of the page (above or inside the Hero section), styled in attractive white text with a subtle contrasting background or overlay, making it immediately visible to visitors.

Update the FloatingContactButtons component so that both the Call and WhatsApp icons have a continuous vibrate + shining/glowing animation. The vibrate effect should be a subtle shake/wiggle keyframe animation, and the shining effect should be a pulsing glow or shimmer that cycles continuously to draw attention.

Refresh the overall page background and section backgrounds to use varied attractive light modern colors — such as soft mint, warm ivory, light peach, pale lavender, or gentle sky tones — alternating across sections so each section feels visually distinct yet cohesive. The primary text and card backgrounds should remain clean white. Avoid dark or heavy colors; keep the palette bright, airy, and modern.

new_feature_requests.summary: Price calculator: scrollable range from 5 to 30 feet, priced at 90 Rs per foot
Background with varied attractive light modern colors
Call and WhatsApp icons with vibrate and shining/glowing animation
Add 'Best Sofa Cleaning Ahmedabad' text/heading at the top
Use attractive white and varied light colors for overall design
